source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor reading change when temperature increase or decrease.
2. Send command: ipmitool sensor list
Check sensor threshold(upper/lower warning/critical) match with the spec
3. Heat up the sensor until higher than the warning and critical threshold
Check SEL when sensor reach to threshold

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.(including sdr type)
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.

original_test_intent: Raise the identified midplane thermal region through approved warning and critical limits, verify its SDR and SEL transitions plus chassis-wide fan/power/backplane/device protection, then prove distributed cooldown and recovery.
original_method: An attended engineer changes the midplane or shared airflow thermal condition while BMC sensors are observed; the source does not locate the sensor or enumerate downstream components sharing that airflow path.
manual_activity: An engineer identifies the midplane sensor and thermal zone, approves and operates a chamber or local fixture that does not compromise shared airflow, and owns chassis recovery. Automation can collect the distributed response matrix.
required_inputs: midplane/backplane revision, physical sensor placement and stable SDR identity
units, accuracy, warning/critical thresholds, tolerance and hysteresis
qualified chamber/local-air stimulus with ramp, dwell, maximum, abort and cooldown
expected SEL event data plus fan, power, link/device, backplane and shutdown responses
independent probes, chassis telemetry, log retention and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Do not obstruct shared chassis airflow or heat an unidentified midplane area; one action may affect many devices and power paths.
Continuously monitor midplane and downstream device temperatures, fans, rails, link/device health, BMC and host; abort on overshoot, link loss, power anomaly or instability.
Preserve/hash existing SEL and component logs; do not clear evidence or auto-retry a distributed failure.
Use approved authenticated access instead of DeepSeek's password exposure and host-key bypass.
Restore airflow, inspect all affected devices and confirm links/power/host health before continuation.
agent_execution_scope: After setup, poll the exact midplane SDR, independent probes, affected component temperatures, fans, power/rails, device links, SEL and console state.
Correlate threshold events and protection timing across the declared coupling matrix rather than considering the midplane channel alone.
Verify cooldown, deassertion and recovery of every affected device/path.
Do not apply heat, modify thresholds, clear logs, reset devices or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the physical/coupling map, thermal/event/protection specification and complete recovery plan.
Operate the environmental fixture with abort authority.
Assess distributed anomalies and issue the DUT verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The SDR/sensor lists are baseline-only and cannot create a midplane transition, inspect SEL, identify affected devices or prove chassis recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use trusted IPMI/SEL collection plus independent midplane and affected-device telemetry synchronized with an engineer-controlled non-obstructive stimulus.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The original commands, midplane target, heat-above-threshold requirement, script and 5/10-minute values remain preserved; the approved chassis plan controls actual timing.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map the sensor and shared thermal zone, baseline every affected device, apply a bounded midplane condition, correlate distributed events/protection, then restore cooling and prove all paths recover.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact chassis, midplane/backplane revision, airflow and attached-device population.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/midplane revision, BIOS/BMC/SDR, device firmware, fixture and probe versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor midplane thermal/airflow limits, SEL mapping and chassis protection/recovery SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical-zone identity, affected-device coupling and distributed recovery evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A midplane sensor transition alone cannot prove that connected devices and shared airflow recovered correctly.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Physical/coupling map, limits, event/protection matrix and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Shared-airflow heating can disrupt multiple accelerators, storage/network devices, connectors or power paths simultaneously.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may choose a chamber or qualified localized fixture and define the populated affected-device matrix; it must record actual method, coupling assumptions, uncovered devices and equivalence limits.
expected_evidence: chassis/midplane identity, sensor location/SDR and affected-device coupling matrix
approved stimulus and calibrated probe plan
timestamped midplane and downstream temperatures plus fan/power/link/device state
decoded SEL warning/critical assert/deassert entries and protection actions
restored airflow, distributed cooldown/deassertion, device/link/host/BMC health and engineer verdict

Physical stimulus remains engineer-controlled while monitoring can be automated, so readiness is conditional rather than permanently blocked.
